description: This PHP source file defines the Installer controller class for the OpenCart admin marketplace module. It manages marketplace extension installation, uninstallation, listing, uploading, and vendor operations within the admin interface.

classes.name: Installer
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions: listing, uploading, installing, uninstalling, and deleting within the OpenCart admin marketplace module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main installer page with breadcrumbs, language setup, and necessary views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to return the list of installed extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the marketplace extension list, including reading marketplace files and retrieving extension data.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the upload of a marketplace extension zip file, validates, extracts install.json data, and registers the extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a specific extension by extracting files from the zip archive and updating the database.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Generates a vendor autoloader file to support extension autoloading.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls an extension, deleting files and database entries.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an extension's zip file and removes its database record.
